name: Cenarius' Legacy
summary: Near Sun Rock Retreat, Cenarius' Legacy turns Braelyn Firehand's grievance into a call to arms. The blood elf mage says the night elves and Cenarius's children suppress the land's magic. She wants them culled at Stonetalon Peak so raw arcane power can flow freely, while their defeat weakens the Alliance presence in the mountains.

sections.title: Stifled Currents
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand lives in the hills near Sun Rock Retreat, frustrated by Stonetalon's natural wards. She says the druids of the Cenarion Circle and the offspring of the demigod Cenarius choke the land's arcane currents. To Braelyn, channeling power here is like drawing water with a perforated bucket. She wants to strip away those defenses and let raw magical energy surge freely again.

sections.title: A Strike at Stonetalon Peak
sections.body: Braelyn sends Horde champions north to Stonetalon Peak to break the wardens' hold. Ancient kaldorei groves and temple grounds there are patrolled by Cenarion Botanists and the proud Sons and Daughters of Cenarius. Striking them down would weaken the wards that muffle Braelyn's spellcraft. It would also deal a bloody blow to the night elf enclave that threatens the Horde's foothold in the mountains.

sections.title: Ties to the Shadow Council
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand longs to return to Jaedenar, a corrupted stronghold of the Shadow Council hidden in Felwood to the north. Her unseen master forbids her return until her work in Stonetalon is done. The Horde aids her for territorial advantage, often unaware of the sinister cult directing her.

faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand is a blood elf spellcaster in the crags near Sun Rock Retreat. She accepts the Horde's aid in clearing the night elves from Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why does Braelyn want the children of Cenarius dead?
faq.answer: Braelyn says the druidic magic of the kaldorei botanists and Cenarius's offspring suppresses raw arcane power across the mountains. She wants to eliminate them so the grove's wards weaken and the freed magic flows into her grasp.
The Sons of Cenarius, Daughters of Cenarius, and Cenarion Botanists are far to the north at Stonetalon Peak. They guard the ancestral ruins, groves, and moonwells maintained by the night elves.

faq.q: What is Jaedenar, which Braelyn mentions?
faq.answer: Jaedenar is a deep canyon and cave complex in Felwood, heavily corrupted by the Burning Legion. It is the Shadow Council's central base of operations in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is the Horde willing to help Braelyn attack Cenarion defenders?
aliases: why does horde kill cenarion circle
faq.answer: The night elves at Stonetalon Peak are aligned with the Alliance and contest the Horde's expansion through the mountains. Weakening their grove helps secure the region for the Horde, whatever Braelyn's personal motives.

faq.q: What happens after completing Cenarius' Legacy?
aliases: what is next in the chain
faq.answer: Afterward, Braelyn's next target is Ordanus, a keeper of the grove at Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale. He is atop the great tree there.

angles.text: As a Tauren druid, killing Cenarius's offspring and Cenarion Circle botanists is a painful divide between faction loyalty and the sacred ways of nature.
As a mage, you may understand the tension between ancient kaldorei wards and free-flowing ley energies. Braelyn's reckless zeal borders on obsession.

As a member of the Horde, you know Stonetalon Peak is the mountain chain's largest bastion of Alliance and kaldorei strength. Clearing its defenders helps safeguard Sun Rock Retreat and the Greatwood Vale.
